operative_text:
SECTION 2 (new): (a) No person shall sell ammunition or shell casings for any firearm unless the purchaser first demonstrates that the purchaser: (1) Is the registered owner of the firearm for which the ammunition or shell casings are to be purchased; or (2) Has been designated by the registered owner of the firearm as an alternate for ammunition purchases on the registration pursuant to section 134-3. (b) Violation of this section is a petty misdemeanor.
SECTION 3 (HRS 134-3(f)): A registered owner of a firearm may designate on the firearm registration an alternate person to be authorized to purchase ammunition. The alternate person may be issued a permit to purchase ammunition for the registered firearm. A permit to purchase ammunition under this subsection shall not last longer than three years.
SECTION 4 (HRS 134-4(d)): (d) No person shall knowingly lend a firearm or transfer ammunition to any person who is prohibited from ownership or possession of a firearm under section 134-7.
SECTION 5 (HRS 134-31): Any person desiring to engage in the business to sell and manufacture firearms or ammunition for sale in the State either at wholesale or retail, shall annually file an application for a license therefor with the director of finance of each county of the State.
